description: Create or update one private Pool Pro Florida CalDAV VEVENT from a Pool Founder route stop. The identity is jobId plus serviceDate, so planned timing can later be replaced by actual arrival and departure without duplication. Owner-only and non-destructive.

address.description: Service address. Written to LOCATION so mobile calendars can open Maps.

email.description: Optional structured customer email from Pool Founder. Included in event notes for tap-to-email on mobile calendars.

end.description: ISO 8601 end with UTC offset or Z. Planned before service; actual departure after completion.

phone.description: Optional structured customer phone number from Pool Founder. Included in event notes for tap-to-call on mobile calendars.

start.description: ISO 8601 start with UTC offset or Z. Planned before service; actual arrival after completion.

name: upsert_route_stop_event
title: Upsert one Pool Founder route stop calendar event
